facts.fact: The Auckland Transport visitor guide connects the gallery with Domain using transport and a final walking leg; current journey times must be checked in the planner.
facts.excerpt: From there, it is a 3-minute walk to the Auckland Art Gallery.

facts.fact: The Mount Eden outing includes a walking leg after public transport rather than private vehicle access to the summit.
facts.excerpt: Walk to Hillside Cresent North and up Puhi Huia Road then follow the track up Mount Eden.

facts.fact: The waterfront route passes Viaduct Harbour on the way to Wynyard Quarter; this city guide requires no cross-harbour trip.
facts.excerpt: Walk for 15 minutes along the Auckland waterfront and past the Viaduct Harbour to Wynyard Quarter.
